question: Given that \(y=(a-1)x^{|a|}+3\) is a linear function, find the value of \(a\).
solution: A linear function requires the exponent of \(x\) to be \(1\), so \(|a|=1\), giving \(a=\pm1\). Also, \(a-1\neq0\), so \(a\neq1\). Therefore, \(a=-1\).
